about: The lane contract for a brief laid onto HyperFrames Studio: what each lane (Studio row) may hold. lane_check.py reads a Studio project's index.html against it and lists every element on a lane it does not belong to.
read_from: brief_layout.py LANES and TRACK: A-roll 1, B-roll 2, Greenscreen 3, Cards 4, End card 5, Captions 6, Song 7, Voice 8

compose.py sound section: the first audio row is 10 (music when there is no voice read), the next row is held for voice cuts, then room tone, then one row per sound effect (13 and up in a brief layout)
compose.py writes each element's lane as data-track-index; a picture's lane comes from the cut sheet's track (display only, layering stays the roll)
brief_layout.py words(): a scene's on-screen words AND a card's lines go on the Captions lane as text, in the piece's one caption style

lanes.not_allowed: a caption line dragged onto A-roll

lanes.allowed: S2 'stands alone with his head down' slot (sprtn-18000-men) on B-roll
lanes.not_allowed: the S4 card (a card scene) dropped onto B-roll
the S17 end card dragged onto Greenscreen

lanes.allowed: S4 'GQ quote' card video (Brief 0322) on Cards
lanes.not_allowed: B-roll footage of the shower scene put on Cards

lanes.allowed: S11 'Get your FLEX' end card (Brief 0322) on End card
lanes.not_allowed: a card scene, or a split's divider line, on End card

lanes.allowed: S1 'The after.' caption line on Captions (a card's lines in caption style count as caption words too)
lanes.not_allowed: a song section, a picture or a sound placed on Captions

lanes.allowed: the 'chorus · Lift your head high…' section on Song
lanes.not_allowed: a caption line dragged onto Song

lanes.allowed: S2 'That reaction? It's real…' voice line on Voice
lanes.not_allowed: the music bed or a whoosh on Voice
a recorded voice read on Music

lanes.allowed: 'Whoosh · S4, the cut on the drop' on Sound effects
lanes.not_allowed: the music bed moved down onto a sound effect row

aroll_clip.seen_as: a

broll_clip.seen_as: a picture whose scene the cut sheet puts on B-roll

greenscreen_clip.seen_as: a picture with class gs, or whose scene the cut sheet puts on Greenscreen

card_picture.seen_as: a picture whose scene the cut sheet puts on Cards

endcard_picture.seen_as: a picture whose scene the cut sheet puts on End card

picture.seen_as: a picture with no cut sheet to say its scene's lane: any picture lane passes

card_text.seen_as: a div with class card or screen; or an offer card layer from scene canvas to_studio (id S9-layer-1, label 'S9 offer · …'); or a card scene's own text on that card's lane

endcard_text.seen_as: a div with class endcard; or an end-card scene's own text on the End card lane

overlay_graphic.seen_as: a div with class lt, ann, ui, disc, icn or lab (lower third, annotation, platform UI, disclaimer, icon, split label)

caption.seen_as: a timed text div with no picture class (brief_layout overlays), or class cap

song_section.seen_as: a marker whose id starts song- or whose label names a section (intro, verse, chorus, bridge, hook, drop, outro)

voice_line.seen_as: a marker whose id starts voice- or whose label starts with a scene and its words

voice_audio.seen_as: an <audio> with id voice, or labelled or named voice

music_audio.seen_as: an <audio> with id music, labelled Music, or a song/music file

sfx_audio.seen_as: an <audio> in the sfx audio group

room_tone.seen_as: an <audio> with room in its id or label

empty_marker.seen_as: a marker labelled 'none in this brief': allowed on every lane

off_the_lanes: Any track that is no lane above (9, or the rows compose uses only in finished edits: 20 spoken captions, 25 card and end card words, 30 overlays, 32–36 graphics) is reported as off the lanes.
gaps_in_compose: 2026-11-07: three rows were found where compose writes an element onto another lane's row (voice audio on 10/11; split divider and labels on 5/6; finished-edit words on 20/25 and graphics on 32–36). The timeline session has fixed all three in its copy: voice on 8, music 10, room tone 12, effects 13+, card words and split parts on 4, end card words on 5, spoken captions and overlays on 6, graphics on 4. The fix waits on its send to origin.
